title: Feature compatibility list
description: The images a feature supports. CI runs the feature's autogenerated and duplicate tests on every entry, in parallel. Conventions: .agents/knowledge/testing.md.

images.description: Supported base images. Every scenario image in scenarios.json must also appear here.

image.description: Image reference passed to `devcontainer features test --base-image`.

arch.description: Architectures to test on; defaults to ["amd64"]. arm64 runs on an arm64 GitHub-hosted runner.

remoteUser.description: Passed as --remote-user to the autogenerated and duplicate tests on this image.

idempotencyExemption.description: Why this feature cannot be installed twice. When set, test/<id>/duplicate.sh is not required; a maintainer approves every exemption.
